summary: One-frame event: a set of entities towards which a temporary hostile relation was created this frame. Written by esv::hit::HitSystem::ProcessHitRequests (Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x3CB050), which builds a local HashMap<EntityHandle, this component> (value stride 0x30), inserts the hit entity into each value set and adds one component per map key; read by esv::relation::RelationSystem (AddRemovedTempRelations). Seen.py context: dialogues/scenes that end in fights (DEN_AttackOnDen, HAV barricade, MOO execution), born with the Removed event and combat merge components.

fields.name: Entities
fields.evidence: Toolkit ctor EoCServer.dll+0x50B5A0 zeroes the 48-byte HashSet shape (+0x1C and +0x2C dwords); move operator= EoCServer.dll+0x50B970 moves bucket table +0/+8, NextIds +0x10/+0x18/+0x1C and Keys +0x20/+0x28/+0x2C. ProcessHitRequests inserts with FUN_18021e210(set, hash, pIVar19) - the same generic 8-byte-key insert it uses for the entity keys of its map - so keys are entity handles. Live: 48 instances, heap pointers at +0/+0x10/+0x20, bucket count 5..17, keys 1..10. Whether the entities are the hit targets or the attackers is not established; the name is neutral.

open_questions: Which side the set holds (targets of the hit or attackers); the component is added to the map-key entities in ProcessHitRequests.
